TYPESAFE_API_KEY.description: Your [TypeSafe](https://typesafe.ai) API key, for the Jev decision model. Enter the word `unset` if you do not have one. **At least one of the three keys must be a real key.**

SUBQ_API_KEY.description: Your SubQ API key, for SubQ Snap. Enter the word `unset` if you do not have one. **At least one of the three keys must be a real key.**

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Your [OpenAI](https://platform.openai.com/api-keys) API key, for OpenAI Decisions. Enter the word `unset` if you do not have one. **At least one of the three keys must be a real key.**
